matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the Bregman divergence definition in Section 2.3 with reversed arguments. Neither finding addresses this defect; pred_id 1 is about calibration error in Section 2.1, and pred_id 2 is about Claim C.3 in the appendix.

GT2 concerns the strong convexity definition in Section 2.4 with the wrong inequality direction (≤ instead of ≥). Neither finding addresses this defect; pred_id 1 is about calibration error normalization, and pred_id 2 is about a different claim in the appendix.

GT3 introduces an erroneous 1/T factor in the calibration error definition in Section 2.1. Pred_id 1 directly identifies this exact defect, noting the inconsistency between the definition with 1/T and its usage elsewhere in the paper without that factor.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Detects GT3's erroneous 1/T normalization factor in the calibration error definition.
Reports an inconsistency in Claim C.3 that is not among the ground truth defects.
